## [PUBLIC] Scope

Project classes define domain-specific tactical requirements for verticals (manufacturing, AI engineering, developer tools, startup growth). Each class file is a charter for Level 3 skill flows in that domain.

## [PUBLIC] Placement

Add a **class charter** (one `.md` per vertical) here. Executable skill flows for a domain go in nested folders (e.g. `startup-growth/mgmt-skills/`) or `skill-flows/` when cross-domain. Core shared behavior elevates to `core-operations/`.

## [PUBLIC] Constraints

- Class charters stay in the parent tree; this snapshot describes placement only.
- `validation_test_case` is a governance fixture, not a domain charter.
- New domain classes MUST pass Board stratification review before promotion.
- Physical or commercial constraints MUST be stated explicitly in the class charter.
